room.name: Boat Dock
room.descript: You find yourself standing on a wooden dock which is over a bay. You can see a pass from the bay out to the ocean to the west. A rocky beach extends to the north and a sandy beach to the south. There are forest to the north east and woods to the south east. Due east lies some small one or two story buildings. Some appear to be commercial shops and others possibly residences. You hear the water splashing the shore line and sea gulls calling.

weather.descript: It is a sunny warm day. There is very little breeze.

exit.descript: This path is very rocky, footing is not sure.
You walk down the dock and onto a path towards town.
The beach sand feels good under your feet.
A path leads you north of the village into a darkening forest of tall firs.
You enter an area south of the village of patchy and somewhat shady oak trees.

room.name: Rocky Shore
room.descript: The bay is to the west. Waves splash hard against the rocky shore. To the north, north east and east you see dark forest of tall evergreen fir trees. To the south east you make out the roofs of a few buildings. To the south the rocks fade into sand along the shore and there appears to be a boat dock.
room.exit: You walk up onto a wooden boat dock.

room.name: Sandy Beach
room.descript: Here the shore is mostly sandy with a few sea shells and some refuse here and there. The waves roll gently ashore. To the north there appears to be a boat dock. To the northeast a town, and to the south east, east and south shady oak wood lands.
room.exit: You walk up to a boat dock.

room.name: Tall Fir Forest
room.descript: The forest is dark with tall evergreen fir trees all around you. Branches and logs lay here and there. Ferns and mushrooms abound. To the south west the trail breaks open with sunlight into what appears to be a bay. To the north east you see a small stream and can hear water bubbling and trickling. Birds are chirping.
room.exit: You exit through a bright opening to reveal a boat dock in front of you.

room.name: Shady Oaks
room.descript: Shady oaks are here and there and sometimes in clumps. Small sunny glades appear here and there along the trail. An occasional bird chirps. Insects buzz about. To the northeast you see a bay and boat dock. To the east a sandy beach.
room.exit: Following a trail leads you under a branch and to a boat dock.

room.name: East End of Town
room.descript: This appears to be a commercial section of a fishing town with a few shops. A building to the north has two stories and is sided with brick. The building to the south is one story and extends down the block with several shops in it. The road is paved with bricks. On the north building you see a sign which says Baytown Inn. The shop to the south says Fishing and Hunting supplies. The street continues to the east.
room.exit: Following the brick road to the west leads you to a boat dock.
